en-US.title: Eve Rider
en-US.subtitle: Request a ride, pick an offer
en-US.description:
Eve connects riders with independent drivers. Request a trip, review fare offers, accept a match, and track your ride. Payment happens off-platform — Eve records the suggested and matched fare for audit and does not collect ride payments.

KEY FEATURES:
• Request bike or car trips with a suggested fare
• Compare driver offers and accept a match
• Live map, pickup, and trip tracking
• Ride history and in-app support

LOCATION
Eve uses your location while you use the app to set pickup and drop-off points and to share your position with your driver during a trip.

PRIVACY
We do not sell your personal information. See the in-app Privacy Policy and your hosted privacy URL in App Store Connect.
en-US.releaseNotes: Initial App Store release of Eve Rider.

review.notes: Eve is a ride-matching marketplace. Payment is off-platform (for example cash). Provide a seeded or staging rider account. Allow location when prompted so maps and trip request work. Privacy Policy and Terms are in the app under Legal.
